    """Reflect the source tile to make a 3-by-2 mirrored tiling."""
    h = len(grid)
    vertical_flip = grid[::-1]
    vertical_tiles = [vertical_flip, grid, vertical_flip]
    out = []
    for tile in vertical_tiles:
        for row in tile:
            out.append(row[::-1] + row[:])
    return out
